verses.greek_plain: και οι κλαιοντεσ ωσ μη κλαιοντεσ και οι χαιροντεσ ωσ μη χαιρον τεσ και οι αγοραζοντεσ ωσ μη κα τεχοντεσ
verses.english_web: and those who weep, as though they didn’t weep; and those who rejoice, as though they didn’t rejoice; and those who buy, as though they didn’t possess;
verses.english_adapted: and those who weep, as though they didn’t weep; and those who rejoice, as though they didn’t rejoice; and those who buy, as though they didn’t possess;

verses.greek_plain: και οι χρωμενοι τον κο σμον ωσ μη καταχρωμενοι παρα γει γαρ το σχημα του κμου τουτου
verses.english_web: and those who use the world, as not using it to the fullest. For the mode of this world passes away.
verses.english_adapted: and those who use the world, as not using it to the fullest. For the mode of this world passes away.

verses.greek_plain: θελω δε υμασ αμεριμνουσ ειναι ο αγαμοσ μεριμνα τα του κυριου πωσ αρεση τω κω
verses.english_web: But I desire to have you to be free from cares. He who is unmarried is concerned for the things of the Lord, how he may please the Lord;
verses.english_adapted: But I desire to have you to be free from cares. He who is unmarried is concerned for the things of the Lord, how he may please the Lord;

verses.greek_plain: ο δε γαμησασ μεριμνα τα του κμου πωσ αρεση τη γυναικι και μεμερισται και η γυνη η αγα μοσ και η παρθενοσ
verses.english_web: but he who is married is concerned about the things of the world, how he may please his wife.
verses.english_adapted: but he who is married is concerned about the things of the world, how he may please his wife.

greek.value: ινα η αγια και σωματι και

verses.greek_plain: μεριμνα τα του κυριου ινα η αγια και σωματι και πνευμα η δε γαμησασα μεριμνα τα του κμου πωσ αρεση τω ανδρι
verses.english_web: There is also a difference between a wife and a virgin. The unmarried woman cares about the things of the Lord, that she may be holy both in body and in spirit. But she who is married cares about the things of the world—how she may please her husband.
verses.english_adapted: There is also a difference between a wife and a virgin. The unmarried woman cares about the things of the Lord, that she may be holy both in body and in spirit. But she who is married cares about the things of the world—how she may please her husband.

verses.greek_plain: τουτο δε προσ το υμων συμφορον λεγω ουχ ινα βροχον υμιν επιβαλω αλλα προσ το ευσχημον και ευπαρεδρον τω κω απερισπαστουσ ειναι
verses.english_web: This I say for your own profit; not that I may ensnare you, but for that which is appropriate, and that you may attend to the Lord without distraction.
verses.english_adapted: This I say for your own profit; not that I may ensnare you, but for that which is appropriate, and that you may attend to the Lord without distraction.

verses.greek_plain: ει δε τισ ασχημονειν επι την παρθενον αυτου νομιζει εαν η υπερακμοσ και ουτω οφιλει γεινεσθαι ο θελει ποιειτω ουχ αμαρτανει γαμειτω σαν
verses.english_web: But if any man thinks that he is behaving inappropriately toward his virgin, if she is past the flower of her age, and if need so requires, let him do what he desires. He doesn’t sin. Let them marry.
verses.english_adapted: But if any man thinks that he is behaving inappropriately toward his virgin, if she is past the flower of her age, and if need so requires, let him do what he desires. He doesn’t sin. Let them marry.

verses.greek_plain: οσ δε εστηκεν τη καρδια αυτου εδραιοσ μη εχων αναγκην εξουσι αν δε εχει περι του ιδιου θελημα τοσ και τουτο κεκρικεν εν τη ιδια καρδια τηρειν την εαυτου παρθε νον καλωσ ποιησει
verses.english_web: But he who stands steadfast in his heart, having no urgency, but has power over his own will, and has determined in his own heart to keep his own virgin, does well.
verses.english_adapted: But he who stands steadfast in his heart, having no urgency, but has power over his own will, and has determined in his own heart to keep his own virgin, does well.

verses.greek_plain: ωστε και ο γα μειζων την εαυτου παρθενον κα λωσ ποιησει και ο μη γαμιζων κρεισσον ποιησει
verses.english_web: So then both he who gives his own virgin in marriage does well, and he who doesn’t give her in marriage does better.
verses.english_adapted: So then both he who gives his own virgin in marriage does well, and he who doesn’t give her in marriage does better.

verses.english_web: A wife is bound by law for as long as her husband lives; but if the husband is dead, she is free to be married to whomever she desires, only in the Lord.
verses.english_adapted: A wife is bound by law for as long as her husband lives; but if the husband is dead, she is free to be married to whomever she desires, only in the Lord.

verses.english_web: But she is happier if she stays as she is, in my judgment, and I think that I also have God’s Spirit.
verses.english_adapted: But she is happier if she stays as she is, in my judgment, and I think that I also have God’s Spirit.

verses.greek_plain: περι δε των ειδωλοθυτων οιδαμεν οτι παντεσ γνωσιν εχο μεν η γνωσισ φυσιοι η δε αγαπη οικοδομει
verses.english_web: Now concerning things sacrificed to idols: We know that we all have knowledge. Knowledge puffs up, but love builds up.
verses.english_adapted: Now concerning things sacrificed to idols: We know that we all have knowledge. Knowledge puffs up, but love builds up.

verses.greek_plain: ει τισ δοκει εγνωκε ναι τι ουπω εγνω καθωσ δει γνω ναι
verses.english_web: But if anyone thinks that he knows anything, he doesn’t yet know as he ought to know.
verses.english_adapted: But if anyone thinks that he knows anything, he doesn’t yet know as he ought to know.

verses.greek_plain: ει δε τισ αγαπα τον θεον ουτοσ εγνωσται υπ αυτου
verses.english_web: But if anyone loves God, the same is known by him.
verses.english_adapted: But if anyone loves God, the same is known by him.

verses.greek_plain: περι τησ
verses.english_web: Therefore concerning the eating of things sacrificed to idols, we know that no idol is anything in the world, and that there is no other God but one.
verses.english_adapted: Therefore concerning the eating of things sacrificed to idols, we know that no idol is anything in the world, and that there is no other God but one.

verses.english_web: that I may know him, and the power of his resurrection, and the fellowship of his sufferings, becoming conformed to his death,
verses.english_adapted: that I may know him, and the power of his resurrection, and the fellowship of his sufferings, becoming conformed to his death,

verses.greek_plain: ει πωσ καταντησω εισ την εξαναστασιν την εκ νεκρων
verses.english_web: if by any means I may attain to the resurrection from the dead.
verses.english_adapted: if by any means I may attain to the resurrection from the dead.

verses.english_web: Not that I have already obtained, or am already made perfect; but I press on, that I may take hold of that for which also I was taken hold of by Christ Jesus.
verses.english_adapted: Not that I have already obtained, or am already made perfect; but I press on, that I may take hold of that for which also I was taken hold of by Christ Jesus.

verses.english_web: Brothers, I don’t regard myself as yet having taken hold, but one thing I do: forgetting the things which are behind, and stretching forward to the things which are before,

verses.english_web: I press on toward the goal for the prize of the high calling of God in Christ Jesus.
